effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash cards in your hand until it has 4 left. Then, play 1 8000 DP or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost. For each card this effect trashed, remove 2000 from this effect's DP maximum.
[All Turns] All of your [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and get +2000 DP.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Dark Dragon]/[Evil Dragon] trait: Cost 3
